WITH ranked_recipes AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT P.POST_SEQ AS "postSeq" , P.POST_TTL AS "title" , P.POST_CN AS "description" , R.RCP_CTG_CD AS "categoryCode" , CT.COM_DTL_DESC AS "categoryName" , R.COOK_MIN AS "cookingMinutes" , R.SERV_QTY AS "servings" , R.RCP_DIF_CD AS "difficultyCode" , DF.COM_DTL_DESC AS "difficultyName" , P.USR_ID AS "authorId" , U.NCK_NM AS "authorName" , U.PRFL_IMG_FIL_SEQ AS "profileImageFilSeq" , TO_CHAR(P.POST_DTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "createdAt" , LIKE_STATS.LIKE_COUNT AS "likeCount" , COMMENT_STATS.COMMENT_COUNT AS "commentCount" , SAVE_STATS.SAVE_COUNT AS "saveCount" , LIKE_STATS.LIKED_BY_ME AS "likedByMe" , SAVE_STATS.SAVED_BY_ME AS "savedByMe" , (P.USR_ID = #{usrId}) AS "mine" , P.POST_DTM AS order_dtm FROM moa.TB_COMM_POST P JOIN moa.TB_RCP R ON R.POST_SEQ = P.POST_SEQ JOIN moa.TB_USR U ON U.USR_ID = P.USR_ID LEFT JOIN moa.TB_COM_CD_DTL CT ON CT.COM_CD = 'RCP_CTG' AND CT.COM_DTL_CD = R.RCP_CTG_CD LEFT JOIN moa.TB_COM_CD_DTL DF ON DF.COM_CD = 'RCP_DIF' AND DF.COM_DTL_CD = R.RCP_DIF_CD LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS LIKE_COUNT , COALESCE(BOOL_OR(L.USR_ID = #{usrId}), FALSE) AS LIKED_BY_ME FROM moa.TB_COMM_POST_LIKE L WHERE L.POST_SEQ = P.POST_SEQ ) LIKE_STATS ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS COMMENT_COUNT FROM moa.TB_COMM_CMT C WHERE C.POST_SEQ = P.POST_SEQ AND C.CMT_STAT = 'ACTIVE' ) COMMENT_STATS ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS SAVE_COUNT , (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE S.USR_ID = #{usrId}) > 0) AS SAVED_BY_ME FROM moa.TB_COMM_POST_SAVE S WHERE S.POST_SEQ = P.POST_SEQ ) SAVE_STATS ON TRUE WHERE P.POST_STAT IN (#{postActive}, 'ACTIVE')
AND P.USR_ID = #{usrId}
AND ( P.VIS_TYP IN (#{publicVisibility}, 'PUBLIC') OR P.USR_ID = #{usrId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM moa.TB_COMM_FOLLOW F WHERE F.FOLLOWER_USR_ID = #{usrId} AND F.FOLLOWING_USR_ID = P.USR_ID AND F.FOLLOW_STAT IN (#{followAccepted}, 'ACCEPTED') ) )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM moa.TB_COMM_POST_SAVE SAVED WHERE SAVED.USR_ID = #{usrId} AND SAVED.POST_SEQ = P.POST_SEQ )
AND R.RCP_CTG_CD = #{categoryCode}
AND ( P.POST_TTL ILIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' OR P.POST_CN ILIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM moa.TB_RCP_INGR RI WHERE RI.POST_SEQ = P.POST_SEQ AND RI.INGR_NM_SNAP ILIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' ) )
ORDER BY (P.USR_ID = #{usrId}) DESC , SAVE_STATS.SAVE_COUNT DESC , P.POST_DTM DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) SELECT R."postSeq" AS "postSeq" , R."title" AS "title" , R."description" AS "description" , R."categoryCode" AS "categoryCode" , R."categoryName" AS "categoryName" , R."cookingMinutes" AS "cookingMinutes" , R."servings" AS "servings" , R."difficultyCode" AS "difficultyCode" , R."difficultyName" AS "difficultyName" , R."authorId" AS "authorId" , R."authorName" AS "authorName" , R."profileImageFilSeq" AS "profileImageFilSeq" , FINISHED_PHOTO.FIL_SEQ AS "finishedPhotoFilSeq" , R."createdAt" AS "createdAt" , R."likeCount" AS "likeCount" , R."commentCount" AS "commentCount" , R."saveCount" AS "saveCount" , R."likedByMe" AS "likedByMe" , R."savedByMe" AS "savedByMe" , R."mine" AS "mine" FROM ranked_recipes R LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT PF.FIL_SEQ FROM moa.TB_COMM_POST_FILE PF JOIN moa.FIL_DTL FD ON FD.FIL_SEQ = PF.FIL_SEQ JOIN moa.TB_COM_CD_DTL MIME ON MIME.COM_CD = 'CONT_TYP' AND MIME.COM_DTL_CD = FD.CONT_TYP AND MIME.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE PF.POST_SEQ = R."postSeq" AND LOWER(MIME.COM_DTL_NM) LIKE 'image/%' ORDER BY PF.SORT_ORD LIMIT 1 ) FINISHED_PHOTO ON TRUE ORDER BY R."mine" DESC , R."saveCount" DESC , R.order_dtm DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.POST_SEQ) FROM moa.TB_COMM_POST_SAVE S JOIN moa.TB_COMM_POST P ON P.POST_SEQ = S.POST_SEQ JOIN moa.TB_RCP R ON R.POST_SEQ = P.POST_SEQ JOIN moa.TB_USR U ON U.USR_ID = P.USR_ID WHERE S.USR_ID = #{usrId} AND P.POST_STAT IN (#{postActive}, 'ACTIVE') AND ( P.VIS_TYP IN (#{publicVisibility}, 'PUBLIC') OR P.USR_ID = #{usrId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM moa.TB_COMM_FOLLOW F WHERE F.FOLLOWER_USR_ID = #{usrId} AND F.FOLLOWING_USR_ID = P.USR_ID AND F.FOLLOW_STAT IN (#{followAccepted}, 'ACCEPTED') ) )

SELECT P.POST_SEQ AS "postSeq" , P.POST_TTL AS "title" , P.POST_CN AS "description" , R.RCP_CTG_CD AS "categoryCode" , CT.COM_DTL_DESC AS "categoryName" , R.COOK_MIN AS "cookingMinutes" , R.SERV_QTY AS "servings" , R.RCP_DIF_CD AS "difficultyCode" , DF.COM_DTL_DESC AS "difficultyName" , P.USR_ID AS "authorId" , U.NCK_NM AS "authorName" , U.PRFL_IMG_FIL_SEQ AS "profileImageFilSeq" , FINISHED_PHOTO.FIL_SEQ AS "finishedPhotoFilSeq" , TO_CHAR(P.POST_DTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "createdAt" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM moa.TB_COMM_POST_LIKE L WHERE L.POST_SEQ = P.POST_SEQ) AS "likeCount" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM moa.TB_COMM_CMT C WHERE C.POST_SEQ = P.POST_SEQ AND C.CMT_STAT = 'ACTIVE') AS "commentCount" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM moa.TB_COMM_POST_SAVE S WHERE S.POST_SEQ = P.POST_SEQ) AS "saveCount" , EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM moa.TB_COMM_POST_LIKE L WHERE L.POST_SEQ = P.POST_SEQ AND L.USR_ID = #{usrId} ) AS "likedByMe" , EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM moa.TB_COMM_POST_SAVE S WHERE S.POST_SEQ = P.POST_SEQ AND S.USR_ID = #{usrId} ) AS "savedByMe" , (P.USR_ID = #{usrId}) AS "mine" FROM moa.TB_COMM_POST P JOIN moa.TB_RCP R ON R.POST_SEQ = P.POST_SEQ JOIN moa.TB_USR U ON U.USR_ID = P.USR_ID LEFT JOIN moa.TB_COM_CD_DTL CT ON CT.COM_CD = 'RCP_CTG' AND CT.COM_DTL_CD = R.RCP_CTG_CD LEFT JOIN moa.TB_COM_CD_DTL DF ON DF.COM_CD = 'RCP_DIF' AND DF.COM_DTL_CD = R.RCP_DIF_CD LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT PF.FIL_SEQ FROM moa.TB_COMM_POST_FILE PF JOIN moa.FIL_DTL FD ON FD.FIL_SEQ = PF.FIL_SEQ JOIN moa.TB_COM_CD_DTL MIME ON MIME.COM_CD = 'CONT_TYP' AND MIME.COM_DTL_CD = FD.CONT_TYP AND MIME.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE PF.POST_SEQ = P.POST_SEQ AND LOWER(MIME.COM_DTL_NM) LIKE 'image/%' ORDER BY PF.SORT_ORD LIMIT 1 ) FINISHED_PHOTO ON TRUE WHERE P.POST_SEQ = #{postSeq} AND P.POST_STAT IN (#{postActive}, 'ACTIVE')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM moa.TB_COMM_POST P JOIN moa.TB_RCP R ON R.POST_SEQ = P.POST_SEQ WHERE P.POST_SEQ = #{postSeq} AND P.USR_ID = #{usrId} AND P.POST_STAT IN (#{postActive}, 'ACTIVE')
SELECT I.INGR_SEQ FROM moa.TB_INGR I WHERE I.INGR_NM = #{ingredientName} AND I.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY I.INGR_SEQ

SELECT RI.SORT_ORD AS "sortOrd" , RI.INGR_SEQ AS "ingrSeq" , RI.INGR_GRP_CD AS "ingredientGroupCode" , RI.INGR_CD AS "ingredientCode" , COALESCE(IC.COM_DTL_DESC, RI.INGR_NM_SNAP) AS "ingrName" , RI.INGR_AMT AS "ingrAmt" , RI.UNIT_CD AS "unitCode" , UC.COM_DTL_DESC AS "unitName" , RI.NOTE AS "note" FROM moa.TB_RCP_INGR RI LEFT JOIN moa.TB_COM_CD_DTL IC ON IC.COM_CD = RI.INGR_GRP_CD AND IC.COM_DTL_CD = RI.INGR_CD LEFT JOIN moa.TB_COM_CD_DTL UC ON UC.COM_CD = 'RCP_UNIT' AND UC.COM_DTL_CD = RI.UNIT_CD WHERE RI.POST_SEQ = #{postSeq} ORDER BY RI.SORT_ORD
SELECT S.STEP_NO AS "stepNo" , S.STEP_CN AS "content" , S.COOK_SEC AS "cookSec" , S.STEP_FIL_SEQ AS "stepFilSeq" FROM moa.TB_RCP_STP S WHERE S.POST_SEQ = #{postSeq} ORDER BY S.STEP_NO

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM moa.TB_COMM_POST P JOIN moa.TB_RCP R ON R.POST_SEQ = P.POST_SEQ WHERE P.POST_SEQ = #{postSeq} AND P.POST_STAT IN (#{postActive}, 'ACTIVE') AND ( P.VIS_TYP IN (#{publicVisibility}, 'PUBLIC') OR P.USR_ID = #{usrId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM moa.TB_COMM_FOLLOW F WHERE F.FOLLOWER_USR_ID = #{usrId} AND F.FOLLOWING_USR_ID = P.USR_ID AND F.FOLLOW_STAT IN (#{followAccepted}, 'ACCEPTED') ) )
